<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers cannot verify third-party bank details before issuing payments, so payments fail and must be reissued days later, delaying claims resolution and impacting financial reserves [i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4] [i:26f44575b6dac473].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Ravensgill Insurance reports that it cannot verify third-party bank info before paying, so payments bounce and are reissued days later [i:0b83ac2d946868a4].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual reports delays in claims payments because third-party bank details cannot be verified ahead of time, causing reissues and unhappy policyholders [i:843469bc1de0a8ce].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting reports a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays [i:2c25d84a8fa1f3d0].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual reports that it cannot validate third-party supplier bank details ahead of time, so payments bounce and are reissued days later [i:9440a16975153d44].\n- Brantwick Commercial reports that bank info is not verified ahead of time when payments go to third parties, leaving it stuck reissuing failed payments days later [i:5195e479ae636965].\n- Marrowgate Commercial reports that payee account verification is not happening before funds are released, causing unnecessary re-issuance delays [i:b017ca6a52bd5c9b].\n- Brackwater Homecover reports that the system throws an error when filtering by supplier payments [i:764b7029f63888a7].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- 7 accounts and 19 mentions are recorded across 3 routes, with 6 mentions on sales, 10 on support and 3 on account management [i:0b83ac2d946868a4] [i:26f44575b6dac473] [i:5195e479ae636965].\n- Total ARR across these accounts is £4,820,000, and 1 renewal falls within 90 days [i:b017ca6a52bd5c9b] [i:0b83ac2d946868a4].\n- Ravensgill Insurance states: \"Right now, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later.\" [i:0b83ac2d946868a4].\n- Ravensgill Insurance also reports that payment detail checking is causing delays [i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual states: \"we need payee account verification to prevent delays. It’s impacting our reserves and supplier reporting too.\" [i:26f44575b6dac473].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual also states: \"We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders. We really need payee account verification built into the workflow.\" [i:ca6e7b08497a30d4].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting states: \"the payee account verification step isn’t happening before the payment is sent out, which causes rework and client frustration.\" [i:f2bfe7e825998ac5].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual states: \"every time we issue payments to third-party suppliers, we can’t validate their bank details ahead of time, which means payments bounce and we’re stuck reissuing days later.\" [i:9440a16975153d44].\n- Brantwick Commercial states: \"It’s frustrating because bounced payments mean we’re reissuing them days later, which messes up our reserves and reporting.\" [i:9bd19c6494c50ad9].\n- Brantwick Commercial also reports that policyholders are starting to notice the delays [i:f0ccd2de01f0e0a0].\n- Marrowgate Commercial states: \"payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays\" [i:b017ca6a52bd5c9b].\n- Brackwater Homecover reports that the system throws an error when filtering by supplier payments [i:764b7029f63888a7].\n\n## Why now\n\n- Marrowgate Commercial, with ARR of £1600000.0, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12, and 1 renewal falls within 90 days [i:b017ca6a52bd5c9b] [i:0b83ac2d946868a4].\n- The issue is reported across 3 routes, with 10 mentions on support, 6 on sales and 3 on account management [i:26f44575b6dac473] [i:0b83ac2d946868a4] [i:5195e479ae636965].\n- Ravensgill Insurance, with ARR of £470000.0, renews on 2027-04-30 [i:0b83ac2d946868a4].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual, with ARR of £690000.0, renews on 2027-02-28 [i:26f44575b6dac473].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting, with ARR of £320000.0, renews on 2027-08-22 [i:2c25d84a8fa1f3d0].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual, with ARR of £980000.0, renews on 2027-09-01 [i:9440a16975153d44].\n- Brantwick Commercial, with ARR of £150000.0, renews on 2027-05-11 [i:5195e479ae636965].\n- Brackwater Homecover, with ARR of £610000.0, renews on 2027-10-10 [i:764b7029f63888a7].\n",

response.content: {"critique": "Every quoted passage matches the cited insight verbatim (e.g., Ravensgill's 'Right now, we can't verify third-party bank info before paying...' and Marrowgate's re-issuance quote). All fact-sheet numbers check out: 7 accounts, 19 mentions, 3 routes (sales 6, support 10, account management 3), total ARR £4,820,000, and account-level ARR and renewal dates all match; the single 90-day renewal is Marrowgate's 2026-12-12, which falls within 90 days of the 2026-11-03 as-of date. The problem statement's reserves impact is supported by the cited Pendleford and Brantwick quotes. Brackwater Homecover's bullet is faithfully reported as a system filter error rather than a verification failure, and is cited accordingly.", "verdict": "pass"}
